About Maki Overseas

A Kathmandu-based agency built on paperwork done right.

Maki Overseas Pvt. Ltd. is a foreign employment service provider licensed by the Ministry of Labour, Employment and Social Security, Government of Nepal. Headquartered in Samakhusi, Tokha-10, Kathmandu, we have been placing Nepali workers in verified jobs abroad since 2019, under continuous government audit and license renewal.

We work directly with employers in the Gulf, Malaysia, and beyond — screening every demand letter before it ever reaches a candidate, so the job offered is the job that's waiting at the airport on the other side.

2019Government approved

Why Choose Us

Licensed at every step, not just on paper.

Foreign employment involves your money, your documents, and your family's future. Here's how we keep it accountable.

Licensed

Government-Audited License

Operating under Foreign Employment License No. 1754/081/082, renewed and inspected by the Department of Foreign Employment.

Verified

Direct Employer Ties

We deal directly with overseas employers and vetted partner agencies — no unauthorized sub-agents handling your file.

Transparent

No Hidden Charges

Service charges are disclosed upfront and follow the government's approved fee structure for each destination country.

Prepared

Pre-Departure Orientation

Every selected worker attends orientation covering the job, the country, labour rights, and safe travel before flying.

Supported

Support After You Land

Our coordination doesn't end at the airport — we stay reachable for workers and families during the contract period.

Documented

Full Paper Trail

Contracts, visas, and demand letters are kept on file and shared with candidates — nothing is verbal-only.

How It Works

From application to airport, in five stages.

01

Register & Screen

Submit your application and documents; our team verifies eligibility for open demands.

02

Interview & Selection

Shortlisted candidates interview directly with the employer or their authorized representative.

03

Documentation & Visa

We process your labour permit, visa, medical, and insurance paperwork end to end.

04

Pre-Departure Orientation

Mandatory orientation on your job, employer, destination country, and worker rights.

05

Departure & Support

Flight, airport assistance, and an ongoing contact point for the length of your contract.

"
Every file that crosses my desk is somebody's son, daughter, or parent trying to build a better life. We don't get to treat that casually — so we don't. Every demand we accept is checked, every worker we send is briefed, and every promise we make is one we can back with paperwork.
Raaz Magar Chief Executive Officer, Maki Overseas Pvt. Ltd.

Apply Now

Send us your application directly.

Fill in the form and it goes straight to our recruitment desk at info@makioverseas.com.np. We'll contact you by phone or email for the next step.

  • No agent fees to submit your application
  • We'll match you to open demands based on your details
  • Attach your CV/resume and citizenship copy if you have them ready

By submitting, your details are sent to info@makioverseas.com.np. We never share your information with third parties.
